_comment: Interior cells that belong to a zone (zones.json id), for interiors a plugin of our own adds that the plugin rule in gamemode.js (REGION_PLUGINS) cannot place. Read by gamemode.js zoneOfActor on every load. Keys are mp descs. Every bank (TheBank, DragonBreak.esp 0x000005) has its cell pinned here, so a player at it always resolves to the bank's hold (per-hold storage, bank.js), never to wherever they last stood outside (bank audit 16 Oct, ck-mcp scan of the 140-plugin order).
